description: The only way to give this round's answer when it is questions for the person. Fill the fields and call it; the platform builds and stores the answer from them. Do not write the answer as text.

parameters.summary: One line summarizing the decision the person must make.
parameters.questions: A non-empty array of strings; only real product or authorization decisions, never invented.
parameters.goalCardDrafts: Only when this request has no goal: optional {objective, completion, autonomy, screening?} drafts; objective one sentence, completion a non-empty array of checkable criteria, autonomy "every_step" or "after_plan_confirmation"; screening {modules, size, conflictsWith, dependsOn, urgency, suggestedPosition, note} with bare moduleId/goalId, size "small"|"medium"|"large"|"unknown", urgency "high"|"normal"|"low", suggestedPosition null or integer >= 0, note at most 512 UTF-8 bytes.
